build: dancer's build — defined shoulders, long legs, no excess
hair: black, thick and wavy, usually worn in a single long braid down her back or twisted into a knot at the nape; she pulls it loose when she's thinking
complexion: warm golden-brown with a slight olive undertone; a small dark mole on her left collarbone
face: a mobile, expressive face — wide-set dark eyes that telegraph every emotion before her mouth catches up, high cheekbones, a full lower lip; the kind of face that makes lying impossible
signature_feature: her hands — long-fingered, precise, with a slight tremor when she's overwhelmed; the left ring finger bears a thin silver band from her grandmother
second_celebrated_feature: the hollow at the base of her throat, visible when she's stressed or breathing hard; the LI notices it before he should
signature_habits: touches the silver ring on her left hand when anxious — a repetitive, unconscious gesture
hums fragments of Tamil film songs (paadal) while working, especially when concentrating
takes her tea with too much milk and no sugar, always in the same chipped ceramic cup
bites the inside of her cheek when she's lying or hiding something — a tell she cannot suppress
reorganizes her workspace when emotionally turbulent, moving things by millimeters until they feel 'right'
occupation: textile designer and owner of a small independent studio (Sutram Textiles) in the city; she sources traditional weaving techniques and creates contemporary fabrics for high-end interior designers and boutique fashion houses

current_crisis.event: her studio's primary investor — a venture capitalist she trusted — has abruptly pulled funding after discovering she rejected his business partner's aggressive acquisition offer; the studio has six weeks of operating capital left, her two employees' salaries are at risk, and she's being quietly blacklisted in her network
current_crisis.hottest_emotion: panic threaded with shame — she feels she's failed the people who depend on her
current_crisis.immediate_want: to find emergency funding without surrendering creative control or admitting publicly that she's drowning

wound.core: she believes that needing help is a failure of character — that self-sufficiency is the only proof of worth
wound.surfacing_hint: when cornered or vulnerable, she becomes hypercontrolling and refuses direct assistance; she'll spiral into catastrophizing before she'll ask for a hand
